Sign in to the registry with your atproto account

Usage: hpy registry login [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]

Arguments:
  [IDENTIFIER]  Your handle or DID

Options:
      --export      Sign in for CI: print a credential to store as the HPY_CREDENTIAL secret instead
                    of saving it here. It is its own session, revocable on its own
      --json        Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --no-browser  Print the authorization URL instead of opening a browser
      --no-input    Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need
                    --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>          Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help        Print help
